bundled_assets.processing: Four original white splatter silhouettes were generated on a flat chroma field; the chroma was removed locally with soft matte and despill to produce a transparent CSS mask atlas.

texture_method: The generated ink field supplies full-page print depth. The generated panel texture is sampled at different offsets per surface. A four-quadrant transparent splatter atlas is used as a CSS mask with per-card color, position, rotation, and sprite selection; no runtime script is executed.
